goal: Independently review Developer-owned implementation and contracts for correctness and maintainability.
decisions: Treat the lifecycle authorization issue as a release blocker.
Accept the Reporter code-edit behavior after the product clarification: editable while open, protected once in_progress.
Treat the shifted-line comparison issue as a US3 correctness defect requiring remediation before final verification.

findings.title: Demoted assigned users can continue lifecycle mutations
findings.evidence: start_work and submit_fix check assignment but not current profile role
findings.recommendation: Add current-role checks and role-demotion regression tests.

findings.title: Index-based code diff misclassifies shifted lines
findings.recommendation: Use alignment-aware diffing or add a line-diff algorithm and shifted-line tests.

findings.title: Corrected Python is not syntax-validated
findings.evidence: fixedPythonCodeSchema validates only non-empty content and length
findings.recommendation: Add safe Python syntax validation or clarify the requirement boundary.

findings.title: Handoff displays the Developer UUID instead of a display identity
findings.recommendation: Load a safe display name or label the identifier appropriately.

acceptance_criteria: Developer behavior matches the specification and contract across US1-US5.
Code comparison remains correct when lines are inserted or removed.
The handoff is maintainable and does not expose internal identifiers unnecessarily.
verification: Reporter open-versus-in_progress code-edit behavior is now specified and covered by regression tests.
Full test suite: 73 passed and 2 suites failed because diff is unavailable.
Typecheck: failed on unavailable CodeMirror and diff dependencies.
remaining_work: Resolve high and medium findings before final verification.
